governing_decision: At max Monk progression with no conventional armor/weapons but WITH legal Curios, every comparable NONCOMBAT final metric should equal 80–90% of fully equipped specialist skills+armor/tools/enchants/affixes/gems AND legal Curios. Use 85% default, 80% for Sea Dragon Luck. Strict Guardian no-worn gear/Curios challenge is a separate test.
applies_to: Same-source personally usable comparable noncombat outcomes including real legal Curios on BOTH players, not class-locked transformations or arbitrary machinery. Excludes combat/health/boss scaling; no automatic Apothic gem slot support for Curios.

formula.specialist_full: F_S = actual measured complete specialist property with legally enhanced armor/tools, all source enchantment+Iesnium+affix including Sigil overcharge+gems, legal Curios, native/Tyz ranks, relevant buffs and caps
formula.monk_target: F_M = measured Monk native+Core+earlier Monk talents+LEGAL CURIOS. New Monk innate rank budget = max(0,target_ratio×F_S−F_M). Curios are not forbidden to Monk and must never be added twice.
formula.monk_rank_curve: Provisional Monk rank (r) contributes max(0, target_ratio*F_S - existing Monk including Curios)*r/N to eligible source effect, then apply per-effect rounding/discrete/caps; distinguish strict no-worn boss test.
formula.when_baseline_zero: Absolute stat units, explicit nonzero reference or observable output distribution required; never multiply 0 vanilla Luck by an arbitrary percent and call that progression
formula.spell_and_gear: All source-specific final attributes/modifiers must be measured in legitimate endgame gear before adding skill effects; no magic industrial tanks or passive machine budgets

calibration_state: NO VERIFIED NUMERIC X VALUES YET. The 100-point example is a normalized index only and does not represent raw Minecraft Luck or an actual equipped Sea Dragon.

luck_example.unit: hypothetical normalized Luck INDEX, not actual MC minecraft:generic.luck
luck_example.note: Sea 75 skills+15 armor/tool+10 legal Curios=100, Monk 10 legal Curios+70 innate=80. Numbers are arbitrary illustrative index units, not actual Luck values. Curios set need not be same item if form restrictions differ; measure their real effects.

gear: Curios and held item Luck modifiers
benchmarks.dedupe: Fortune, Looting and generic loot amount are NOT the Luck attribute
Does not multiply one shared Ars/Iron pool twice; industrial mana tanks excluded
Cannot compare a Monk who lacks the required native harvest-tier unlock against a tool that can mine the block
Never multiply the same loot event twice or count machines/automatic farms

gear: valid breeding speed equipment/bonuses, if any
benchmarks.dedupe: Does not create extra animals from a single parent; maturation vs breeding separate measures
Do not treat flying, swimming and teleporting as the same measurement
No free creative flight; respect collision and traversability
Not universally comparable: Monk cannot be assumed to acquire JAWR blood physiology or lich soul/phylactery
COMBAT stat: excluded from universal 80-90% NONCOMBAT rule; separate gear-normalized combat rule
Separate from generic Luck and exclude static boss/advancement drops

gaps: Monk currently has no generic Luck attribute skill: add `tmm_monk_inner_fortune` as DESIGN ONLY and verify real Luck consumers.
Monk has no native intrinsic capacity equal to 85% of full geared Dragon: add late `tmm_monk_inner_reservoir` candidate but do not activate without real per-mod mana baselines.

Monk's native Gardening/Hazard/Fortune and proper harvest tier gates may not match optimized Forest crop output: add `tmm_monk_worldly_cultivation` candidate, then benchmark and avoid duplicate harvest.
The 1.2^P XP divisor makes 50-rank skills exceptionally expensive; decide whether all-tree Monk max is a reachable survival target and whether endgame fixed MXP milestones cover it.
No actual source-verified gear stat maximum measured for Luck, manacap, farming tools or high-tier attributes. Raw x is unknown until pinned mechanics/gear are audited.
Affix overcharge Sigil of Supremacy 1.5 / Malice 2.0 and excessive gem Luck can make Sea fully optimized X enormous; preserve 0.8 ratio as design target only, never commit untested raw Monk Luck.
qa: Record per-mod gearless/gear-only/skill-only/full-build baseline and actual final attribute at representative rank checkpoints.

For Sea Luck verify genuine supported player Luck attribute and all real loot contexts that read it, then pick a buildable fully optimized gear template and compute target capped Monk=0.8×measured Sea X.
For each noncombat row, run same task with equivalent legal source, claims and world conditions, including source-verified debits and no double-dip.
Ensure Monk abilities suspend when wearing conventional armor or weapons as required, and that armor-lock self-damage/safe-swap rules remain separate.
Do not apply 85% to all magic schools without source support or automatically grant species-locked blood/hybrid/immortality.
On same player record no Curios / each Curio individually / full Curios for Monk and specialist before deriving Inner Fortune baseline; separate strict Guardian zero-worn trial.

curios_policy.normal_monk: Curios are allowed; compute actual Monk base and legal Curio contribution, including potential Draconic chestpiece body slot only after source/client verification
curios_policy.normal_specialist: Includes full enchanted/Affixed weapons/armor and legal Curios; no implied Curio affixability
curios_policy.strict_guardian: Preserve separate zero-worn-items incl Curios, no-weapons Monk Chaos Guardian challenge from prior request
